## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so it now contradicts the code change in `app/cli.py:3`. This should be fixed. The code change and its updated default test are otherwise consistent.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README timeout default to 60 seconds — With no `--timeout` flag, requests now time out after 60 seconds, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." This contradicts `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`. — Users who rely on the README will expect 30-second timeouts and may set the wrong `--timeout` value. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds, or reference `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`, in this pull request.
